posts.title: Meet Blanc Browser
posts.description: A new browser popped up on the radar over the weekend: Blanc Browser . Your tabs, search, and commands all live in what looks like the Dynamic Island from an iPhone. They take a more website, less browser approach. Always happy to give new browsers a spin. Blanc is still very new, but it's fun like Helium and it will be neat to see where these projects go. ✉️ Reply by Email
